4. **Tables**: All 8 declared tables (stay_grid, itinerary_grid, traveler_grid, readiness_grid, supplier_grid, exception_grid, release_seal_grid) are rendered with correct data-testid, row data attributes, and data-col cell selectors.

5. **Service calls**: Real fetch() calls to /api/tier-c-quote (GET with query), /api/tier-c-promo (GET with query), /api/tier-c-holds (POST JSON), /api/tier-c-payment (POST JSON). Each appends to S['__services.calls'] with service name, enabling derived call counts.

6. **File uploads**: input[type=file] elements with change handlers that use FileReader + CSV parser. Columns are typed per schema (string/number/boolean).

7. **Role gates**: unauthorized_effects applied when active_role not in allowed_roles, incrementing denied_count. Controls remain clickable (not disabled).

8. **Conflict detection**: release_supplier_holds checks conflict_when (hold_count > 0 AND draft_version != version) first, applies conflict_effects.

9. **Rejected semantics**: seal_release checks rejected_when (booking_status not confirmed) and applies rejected_effects (tier_d_seal_status=blocked).

10. **Derived state**: recompute() recalculates all derived fields (leg_count, trip_subtotal, addon_total, service_fee piecewise, total_due linear, traveler counts, document counts, hold counts, payment counts, checklist count, exception counts, audit counts, service call counts) on every commit.

11. **Normalization**: promo_code uses trim+uppercase; payment_amount_key uses currency_number (strips non-digits/decimal, re-stringifies as integer when whole).

12. **appended_object id semantics**: For payment_ledger and audit_events, id is set to the before-action count (which equals the 0-based index of the new item after append).

13. **Visual design**: Dark war-room theme with gradient heroes per page, stat cards on command center, data grids with sticky headers, color-coded status cells, score circle widget, and role-aware action clusters."
